name: get_contact
title: Get Contact
description: Get detailed information about a specific contact.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

contact_id.description: The contact ID (e.g., "c1234567890" or full resource name "people/c1234567890").

name: get_contact_group

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

max_members.description: Maximum number of members to return (default: 100, max: 1000).

name: get_events
title: Get Events
description:
Retrieves events from a specified Google Calendar. Can retrieve a single event by ID or multiple events within a time range.
You can also search for events by keyword by supplying the optional "query" param.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

calendar_id.description: The ID of the calendar to query. Use 'primary' for the user's primary calendar. Defaults to 'primary'. Calendar IDs can be obtained using `list_calendars`.

event_id.description: The ID of a specific event to retrieve. If provided, retrieves only this event and ignores time filtering parameters.

time_min.description: The start of the time range (inclusive) in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2024-05-12T10:00:00Z' or '2024-05-12'). If omitted, defaults to the current time when single_events=True. It is omitted from unexpanded queries so recurring masters that began in the past but still have future occurrences remain discoverable. Ignored if event_id is provided.

time_max.description: The end of the time range (exclusive) in RFC3339 format. If omitted, events starting from `time_min` onwards are considered (up to `max_results`). Ignored if event_id is provided.

max_results.description: The maximum number of events to return in one page. Defaults to 25. Ignored if event_id is provided.

query.description: A keyword to search for within event fields (summary, description, location). Ignored if event_id is provided.

detailed.description: Whether to return detailed event information including description, location, colour (colorId), attendees, and attendee details (response status, organizer, optional flags). Recurring instances also report the parent series ID needed to edit the whole series; recurring masters report their raw RFC5545 recurrence rules; and events that are not ordinary confirmed meetings report their event type (outOfOffice, workingLocation, focusTime) and status. Defaults to False.

include_attachments.description: Whether to include attachment information in detailed event output. When True, shows attachment details (fileId, fileUrl, mimeType, title) for events that have attachments. Only applies when detailed=True. Set this to True when you need to view or access files that have been attached to calendar events, such as meeting documents, presentations, or other shared files. Defaults to False.

single_events.description: Whether to expand recurring series into individual instances. Defaults to True for backwards compatibility. Set to False with detailed=True to retrieve recurring master events and their exact RFC5545 recurrence rules instead of inferring cadence from expanded instances.

page_token.description: Token for the next page, taken from a previous response. When single_events=True, also pass the response's Pagination time_min as time_min, even if omitted on the first call. Keep all other query parameters unchanged. Ignored if event_id is provided.

name: get_gmail_attachment_content
title: Get Gmail Attachment Content
description:
Downloads an email attachment and saves it to local disk.

In stdio mode, returns the local file path for direct access.
In HTTP mode, returns a temporary download URL (valid for 1 hour).
May re-fetch message metadata to resolve filename and MIME type.

message_id.description: The ID of the Gmail message containing the attachment.

attachment_id.description: The ID of the attachment to download.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

return_base64.description:
When True, includes the full attachment as a
standard base64 string in the response (in addition to any file
path or download URL). Useful for sandboxed clients that cannot
reach localhost download URLs or the MCP server's local file
paths (e.g. containerized agents with network allowlists). The
returned base64 uses the standard alphabet, so it can be passed
directly to tools like ``draft_gmail_message`` that expect
standard (not URL-safe) base64. Default False preserves the
existing behavior and response size.

attachment_index.description:
Zero-based attachment position from
the message-content response. Lets the server resolve Gmail's
refreshed attachment IDs against current metadata before every
download, selecting the current attachment ID, filename and MIME type.

name: get_gmail_message_content
title: Get Gmail Message Content
description:
Retrieves the full content (subject, sender, recipients, body) of a specific Gmail message.

Bodies are returned inline and truncated at 20,000 characters. Set full=True to
get the complete, untruncated message instead: it is exported to storage and the
response carries a short-lived download URL (HTTP transport) or file path (stdio
transport) rather than the body, so large messages never stream through the model
context. Stateless deployments without GCS staging have no storage, so there
full=True returns the untruncated body inline; with GCS staging configured it
returns a signed download URL like any other HTTP deployment.

message_id.description: The unique ID of the Gmail message to retrieve.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

body_format.description: Body output format (only applies when format='full'). 'text' (default) returns plaintext (HTML converted to text as fallback). 'html' returns the raw HTML body as-is without conversion. 'raw' fetches the full raw MIME message and returns the base64url-decoded content.

full.description: When True, return the COMPLETE untruncated message: saved to storage and referenced by download URL/file path instead of the body text. In stateless mode without GCS staging, the body is returned inline; with GCS staging, a signed download URL is returned. Use for messages large enough to hit the truncation limit, or when byte-exact fidelity is needed (pair with body_format='raw' for a .eml export).

format.description:
Message format. "full" (default) includes
the body and attachments, "metadata" only headers.

name: get_gmail_messages_content_batch
title: Get Gmail Messages Content Batch
description:
Retrieves the content of multiple Gmail messages in a single batch request.
Supports up to 25 messages per batch to prevent SSL connection exhaustion.

message_ids.description: List of Gmail message IDs to retrieve (max 25 per batch).

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

format.description: Message format. "full" includes body, "metadata" only headers.

body_format.description: Body output format (only applies when format='full'). 'text' (default) returns plaintext (HTML converted to text as fallback). 'html' returns the raw HTML body as-is without conversion. 'raw' fetches the full raw MIME message and returns the base64url-decoded content.

name: get_gmail_thread_content
title: Get Gmail Thread Content
description:
Retrieves the complete content of a Gmail conversation thread, including all messages.

Optionally also returns structured ownership analysis so a caller can
determine who sent the last message and who owes whom a response without
re-parsing the formatted string or making a second tool call.

thread_id.description: The unique ID of the Gmail thread to retrieve.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

body_format.description: Body output format. 'text' (default) returns plaintext (HTML converted to text as fallback). 'html' returns the raw HTML body as-is without conversion. 'raw' fetches each message's full raw MIME content and returns the base64url-decoded body.

include_analysis.description: When True, the return value is a dict with both the formatted thread content AND structured ownership analysis (last sender, ball-in-court verdict, per-sender message counts, participants). Defaults to False, in which case the existing string return shape is preserved.

name: get_gmail_threads_content_batch
title: Get Gmail Threads Content Batch
description:
Retrieves the content of multiple Gmail threads in a single batch request.
Supports up to 25 threads per batch to prevent SSL connection exhaustion.

thread_ids.description: A list of Gmail thread IDs to retrieve. The function will automatically batch requests in chunks of 25.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

body_format.description: Body output format. 'text' (default) returns plaintext (HTML converted to text as fallback). 'html' returns the raw HTML body as-is without conversion. 'raw' fetches each message's full raw MIME content and returns the base64url-decoded body.

name: get_task
title: Get Task
description: Get details of a specific task.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

task_list_id.description: The ID of the task list containing the task.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to retrieve.

name: get_task_list
title: Get Task List
description: Get details of a specific task list.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

task_list_id.description: The ID of the task list to retrieve.

name: list_calendars
title: List Calendars
description: Retrieves a list of calendars accessible to the authenticated user.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

max_results.description: Maximum calendars to return in one page. Omit to use the API default.

page_token.description: Token for the next page, taken from a previous response.

name: list_contact_groups
title: List Contact Groups
description: List contact groups (labels) for the user.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

page_size.description: Maximum number of groups to return (default: 100, max: 1000).

name: list_contacts
title: List Contacts
description: List contacts for the authenticated user.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

page_size.description: Maximum number of contacts to return (default: 100, max: 1000).

name: list_gmail_labels
title: List Gmail Labels
description: Lists labels in the user's Gmail account.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

prefix.description:
Return only labels whose name starts with this
exact (case-sensitive) string. users.labels.list accepts no filter,
so the full list is fetched and narrowed here: this shrinks what the
caller receives, not the API call.

include_system.description:
Include Gmail system labels (INBOX, SENT, ...).
Set False to return user labels only.

name: list_task_lists
title: List Task Lists
description: List all task lists for the user.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

max_results.description: Maximum number of task lists to return (default: 1000, max: 1000).

name: list_tasks
title: List Tasks
description: List all tasks in a specific task list.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

task_list_id.description: The ID of the task list to retrieve tasks from.

max_results.description: Maximum number of tasks to return. (default: 20, max: 10000).

show_completed.description: Whether to include completed tasks (default: True). Note that show_hidden must also be true to show tasks completed in first party clients, such as the web UI and Google's mobile apps.

show_deleted.description: Whether to include deleted tasks (default: False).

show_hidden.description: Whether to include hidden tasks (default: False).

show_assigned.description: Whether to include assigned tasks (default: False).

completed_max.description: Upper bound for completion date (RFC 3339 timestamp).

completed_min.description: Lower bound for completion date (RFC 3339 timestamp).

due_max.description: Upper bound for due date (RFC 3339 timestamp).

due_min.description: Lower bound for due date (RFC 3339 timestamp).

updated_min.description: Lower bound for last modification time (RFC 3339 timestamp).

name: query_freebusy
title: Query Freebusy
description: Returns free/busy information for a set of calendars.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

time_min.description: The start of the interval for the query in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2024-05-12T10:00:00Z' or '2024-05-12').

time_max.description: The end of the interval for the query in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2024-05-12T18:00:00Z' or '2024-05-12').

calendar_ids.description: List of calendar identifiers to query. If not provided, queries the primary calendar. Use 'primary' for the user's primary calendar or specific calendar IDs obtained from `list_calendars`.

group_expansion_max.description: Maximum number of calendar identifiers to be provided for a single group. Optional. An error is returned for a group with more members than this value. Maximum value is 100.

calendar_expansion_max.description: Maximum number of calendars for which FreeBusy information is to be provided. Optional. Maximum value is 50.

name: search_contacts
title: Search Contacts
description: Search contacts by name, email, phone number, or other fields.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

query.description: Search query string (searches names, emails, phone numbers).

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 30, max: 30).

name: search_gmail_messages
title: Search Gmail Messages
description:
Searches messages in a user's Gmail account based on a query.
Returns both Message IDs and Thread IDs for each found message, along with Gmail web interface links for manual verification.
Supports pagination via page_token parameter.

query.description: The search query. Supports standard Gmail search operators.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

page_size.description: The maximum number of messages to return. Defaults to 10.

page_token.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results. Use the next_page_token from a previous response.

include_headers.description:
If True, also fetch each message's metadata and include
Subject, From, and Date per result. Costs one metadata get per result,
grouped into HTTP batches of up to 10, plus retries for transient failures.
Defaults to False (output unchanged from prior versions).
